lines.text: Hey Arthur! What kind of salary can I expect here?
lines.caps: Hey Arthur! | What kind of salary | can I expect here?

lines.text: Ah rookie... in corporate life, there are six types of salaries.
lines.caps: Ah rookie... | in corporate life, | there are 6 types of salaries.

lines.text: Number one: The Onion Salary. The moment you touch it, you start crying!
lines.caps: 1. THE ONION SALARY 🧅 | The moment you touch it, | you start crying!

lines.text: Number two: The Damned Salary. It doesn't help you, it makes you suffer... but you can't live without it!
lines.caps: 2. THE DAMNED SALARY 🔥 | It makes you suffer... | but you CANNOT | live without it!

lines.text: Number three: The Agnostic Salary. You constantly doubt whether it actually exists.
lines.caps: 3. THE AGNOSTIC SALARY 🕵️‍♂️ | You constantly DOUBT | whether it actually exists!

lines.text: Number four: The Magic Salary. Now you see it... and now you don't!
lines.caps: 4. THE MAGIC SALARY 🎩✨ | Now you see it... | and NOW YOU DON'T!

lines.text: Number five: The Period Salary. Comes once a month... and lasts for four days!
lines.caps: 5. THE PERIOD SALARY 📅 | Comes once a month... | and lasts for 4 days!

lines.text: And number six: The Impotent Salary. When you need it the most... it completely lets you down!
lines.caps: 6. THE IMPOTENT SALARY 📉 | When you need it the most... | it COMPLETELY | lets you down!

lines.text: Wait... which one do we get?!
lines.caps: Wait... | which one do WE get?!
